flex-col gap-6 desktop:flex-row desktop:items-start desktop:gap-[200px]"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-start py-4 desktop:shrink-0"><h2 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-[28px] leading-[37px] font-semibold text-(--Labels-Primary)">常见问题</h2></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col w-full desktop:flex-1 desktop:min-w-0"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) border-t-[0.5px]"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-1" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">Kimi Agent 集群是什么？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 arrow-icon--open"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-1" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid answer-grid--open"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) answer-text--open">Kimi Agent 集群是一支围绕同一个复杂目标协同工作的 AI 团队。相比由单个 Agent 按顺序处理全部任务，Agent 集群可以把工作拆分给多个 Agent，让它们分别负责不同部分，并在任务推进过程中持续协作、汇总进展。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-2" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">为什么要用 Agent Swarm，而不是普通 Agent？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-2" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">普通 Agent 更适合目标明确、范围相对集中的任务；Agent Swarm 更适合步骤更多、周期更长、需要多种能力协同的复杂项目。多个 Agent 可以同时进行研究、分析、开发、验证等工作，不必让一个 Agent 从头到尾串行完成所有事情。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-3" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">Agent Swarm 适合做什么？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-3" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">Agent Swarm 适合需要多类工作协同推进的复杂任务，例如深度研究与分析、软件开发、大量信息整理与可视化、多步骤业务工作，以及多角色、多视角的模拟与推演等。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-4" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">Agent Swarm 是怎么协同工作的？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-4" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">Kimi 会把复杂目标拆成不同的工作流，并交给适合的子 Agent 执行。有的 Agent 负责探索，有的负责开发，也可以有 Agent 负责验证结果。主 Agent 会持续跟进各部分进展、接收新发现，并让不同工作在项目推进过程中保持协调。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-5" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">不同的子 Agent 会有不同分工吗？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-5" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">会。根据任务需要，Swarm 可以使用适合不同工作的 Agent，例如通用执行、编码、探索和验证等。这样，一个复杂项目中的不同部分可以由不同 Agent 各司其职，而不是让单个 Agent 承担所有工作。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-6" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">Agent Swarm 运行过程中，我还能调整需求吗？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-6" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">可以。Swarm 开始运行后，你仍然可以补充信息、明确需求或调整方向，不需要等当前这一轮全部结束后再重新开始。这样，任务可以随着你的想法和实际需求持续调整。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-7" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">子 Agent 能记住之前做过的工作吗？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-7" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">可以。在长任务和多轮任务中，已有的子 Agent 可以被再次调用，并延续此前的工作上下文。这样可以减少重复理解背景和重新探索，也能降低多轮任务中的信息损耗，让工作更连续。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-8" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">Agent 集群执行任务时会比普通智能体模式消耗更多积分吗？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 "><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-8" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) ">会。Agent 集群任务通常消耗普通 Agent 任务数倍的积分，具体取决于任务复杂度和参与的子 Agent 数量。</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--component
